title: Non-escape from uniformly expanding finite orbits under C2 random diffeomorphisms with logarithmic moments of order above one
source_title: Hyperbolicity for large automorphism groups of projective surfaces
author: Serge Cantat; Romain Dujardin
difficulty_reason: The prior Margulis occupation theorem does not provide the needed drift from tangent expansion alone under a logarithmic moment of order just above one. The authors build the logarithmic-distance function and combine a bounded-map second-order Taylor comparison with a separate large-norm moment-tail estimate, choosing the neighborhood and cutoff so both errors preserve the expansion drift. This nonlinear drift construction is the remaining nonroutine step beyond the precise prior occupation theorem; no stronger exponential-moment assumption is introduced.

historical_source_pdf_evidence.original_difficulty_reason: The authors transfer tangent expansion into a nonlinear logarithmic-distance drift using a truncation that controls unbounded second derivatives under only logarithmic moments, then apply a sharp Markov recurrence criterion. This nonlinear random-dynamics construction exceeds qualifying-exam ergodic theory.
